identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of Investigational Drug X in Patients With Breast Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 2, Open-Label Study of Drug X in HER2-Positive Metastatic Breast Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study is testing whether Drug X can slow the growth of breast cancer. Participants will receive Drug X and be monitored closely. The main goal is to measure tumor response. Safety will also be tracked throughout the study.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: A long detailed description that spans many pages of protocol text.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Confirmed diagnosis of HER2-positive breast cancer
* Able to attend study visits
* Adequate organ function

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant or breastfeeding
* Serious uncontrolled infection
